ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions of child care centers involved in the alleged fraud to identify any suspicious activity
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
What steps can be taken to prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions of the child care centers involved, we may be able to identify patterns of suspicious activity and shed light on how the alleged fraud occurred.
